rationale: The protected phrasing held: “differences were associated with restoration status” became “Both contrasts were associated with restoration status,” preserving its noncausal strength. All reported values, decimal places, CI bounds, p-values, sample details, and citations were retained unchanged. “The restoration-by-canopy interaction was positive (0.092...)” only makes explicit the sign already conveyed by 0.092; it does not alter the claim. The remaining changes restructure the descriptive contrasts and model estimates and move statistics into parentheses, as authorized.
